routeNotes: When you arrive to the park, you'll meet your guide by the company truck and trailer. Look for the blue and green kayaks, or our company name and logo on the side of the truck. They will provide parking instruction and where to find the restroom. Waivers must be signed for all individuals in your party. Once all guests have arrived and waivers are signed, your guide will bring you to the launch to provide you with the basics to kayaking and hazards to watch out for to ensure a safe and fun adventure. The guide will launch you into the water and begin the tour. You will return to the same location at the launch 2 hours later. Please note that your feet and bottom half will get wet, so plan your attire accordingly.
restrictions: Ages 12 and under must be in a tandem kayak with an adult
Not recommended for individuals who have recently had shoulder or back injuries or surgeries
bring: Sun protection like sunscreen, hats or sun protective clothing
Water is required to be brought by all guests!
Towel to help dry off after the tour
facts.cancellation: Customers receive a full refund for cancellations 48 hours before the booking. Cancellations, changes, or no-shows within 48 hours are charged in full. Operator cancellations get a full refund.
facts.accessibility: Yes, but there would need to be someone to assist individual into kayak. All personal items must be stored in vehicle, no storage space.

By the end of your adventure you will leave with amazing memories and have learned amazing facts from your passionate guide! We cannot wait to explore with you!

title: Dolphin and Manatee Adventure Tour of Naples with Olde Florida History
operator: Three Brothers Boards Paddle Board Tours
paragraphs: Guests paddle on the water for the whole outing. Time on the water is about 2 hours. A guide stays with the group and chooses the water from recent sightings. The watch includes dolphins, manatees, sea turtles, and conchs. Birds along the same water include bald eagles, pelicans, and osprey.

The West Indian manatee is the animal this water is known for. The water around the city is the setting, picked for the animals that live there. The group moves at an easy pace, with time to watch rather than cover a set distance. Sea life and birds are both part of what the guide is looking for.
Manatees, when they are present, are why many guests book this water. Which animals appear depends on the day, and a sighting is not promised.
